test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. Three walls have posters with prayers printed in large letters.

B. It is very sparsely furnished.

C. The fourth has a chart with a family tree of the organisation.

D. I await Mother Teresa in her office.
solution:
The correct answer is '**DBAC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
 
• **Sentence D** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence i.e. the speaker waiting for Mother Teresa in her office.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the next sentence because **Sentence D **talks about the office and it further explains what the office looked like.
 
• **Sentence A **will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly,** Sentence C **will be used.
 
• Thus the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **D**: I await Mother Teresa in her office.
 
• **B**: It is very sparsely furnished.
 
• **A**: Three walls have posters with prayers printed in large letters.
 
• **C**: The fourth has a chart with a family tree of the organisation.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *I await Mother Teresa in her office. It is very sparsely furnished. Three walls have posters with prayers printed in large letters. The fourth has a chart with a family tree of the organisation.*
